title: QCAD dxflib comparator and lineage screen
scope: Broaden the open-source DXF/DWG implementation comparator inventory beyond the peer routes already recorded in the parity plan
Determine whether standalone QCAD dxflib offers a bounded independent 2D DXF comparison route
Separate library declarations and observable callbacks from application-level, proprietary, binary-DXF, DWG, and semantic support claims
Record implementation readiness and cost without expanding required tests or promoting support claims

sourceTypes: Official QCAD dxflib feature, download, overview, and writer documentation
Public QCAD source tree and license
Historical LibreCAD project note used only as an unverified lineage lead
method.limitations: Official pages and the qcad/qcad master source are mutable and were not resolved to a release archive hash. No exact-source ancestry or copied-code audit, source build, runtime trial, or external drawing test was performed.

sources.revision: Official mutable feature page; lists source release 3.26.4; archive SHA-256 not captured
sources.observed: Declares reading all DXF format versions for a bounded set of HEADER, table, block, entity, XRECORD, and XDATA content; declares writing DXF R15/AC1015. These are feature claims, not test results or completeness proof.
Lists the dxflib 3.26.4 source release. Exact archive contents and hash were not fetched.

sources.revision: Generated mutable API reference; reports DL_VERSION 3.26.4.0
sources.observed: Provides public API/version corroboration, but does not establish the exact downloaded archive or runtime behavior.
Describes a callback-oriented parser that delivers supported objects to a consumer rather than retaining a complete drawing model.
Documents order-sensitive writer calls and older R12/DXF 2000/2002 profiles. The current feature page lists AC1015 only; exact current release behavior needs direct verification before use.

sources.revision: Mutable qcad/qcad master; not tied to the listed 3.26.4 archive
sources.observed: The reviewed readDxfGroups route consumes text group-code/value lines via line-reading helpers and dispatches supported content. This screen did not establish binary-DXF support, raw-group preservation, or a full unsupported-record skip census.
Identifies dxflib under GPL-2.0-or-later; commercial QCAD add-ons are a separate product component and cannot be used to infer standalone dxflib DWG or extended-DXF support.
Separates community source from commercial plugin functionality; application-level open/save results would not qualify as dxflib-only evidence.
Describes a historical switch from older dxflib usage to libdxfrw due to maintenance/coverage concerns. This is a lead only; no Git ancestry or source-similarity audit was done.

localCrossCheck.assessment: The plan already records multiple peer and consumer routes. Standalone dxflib was not present in the comparator inventory. No local code, tests, or fixture corpus were changed or executed for this research slice.

potentialScope: ASCII DXF common 2D entities and fields actually exposed through dxflib callbacks
Optional writer smoke experiment limited to locally generated ASCII AC1015 controls after exact artifact pinning
notQualified: 3DSOLID, REGION, BODY, SURFACE, or MESH semantics
ACAD_TABLE and arbitrary object/reference graph completeness
native CAD acceptance or independent semantic expected values
implementationDisposition.independence: UNVERIFIED; exact source history and copied/shared-code audit required before counting as an independent parser vote

validation.scopedDiffCheck: PASS (git diff --check on the plan and receipt paths)

evidenceLimits: Public feature matrices describe intended coverage but do not provide per-version or per-record execution evidence.
The current mutable source view was not pinned to the listed release archive, so implementation details may differ in 3.26.4.
A successful callback parse would establish only projected supported records, not unknown data retention, owner/reference closure, semantic round-trip, or native acceptance.
QCAD application and proprietary plugin capabilities are excluded from all standalone dxflib claims.
Historical migration notes do not substitute for a source ancestry or code-similarity audit.
